scene: A small game scene, 480×360: a blue sky, a green ground along the bottom, three wooden crates standing on the ground, a translucent blue glass panel in front of the middle of them, a ring of glowing sparks above, a health bar at the top-left, and a minimap at the top-right that shows a yellow dot for each crate.

bugs.symptom: The three crates are missing.
bugs.diagnosis: The crates are drawn with a negative width, which reverses their winding. Back-face culling is on (CULL_FACE, cull BACK, front face CW), so every crate is culled: the three crate draws change no pixels.
bugs.fix: Do not flip a sprite with a negative size while culling is on: disable culling for sprites, or flip the texture coordinates instead.

bugs.symptom: The crates are drawn black.
bugs.diagnosis: The crate texture has one mip level, but its MIN_FILTER is still the default NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR, which needs a full mip chain. The texture is incomplete, so it samples as black.
bugs.fix: Call generateMipmap after the upload, or set MIN_FILTER to LINEAR or NEAREST.

bugs.symptom: The glass panel is opaque. The crates behind it cannot be seen through it.
bugs.diagnosis: Blending is not enabled when the glass panel is drawn, so its colour replaces what is behind it instead of mixing with it.
bugs.fix: Enable BLEND with blendFunc(SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) before drawing the glass.

bugs.symptom: The ground is the wrong colour. It should be green.
bugs.diagnosis: The ground's draw never sets the tint uniform, so it uses the value left by the draw before it: the minimap's dots, (1, 0.8, 0.2, 1).
bugs.fix: Set the tint uniform to the ground's colour before drawing it.

bugs.symptom: Only the sky and the HUD are drawn. The ground, the crates, the glass panel and the sparks are all missing.
bugs.diagnosis: The depth buffer is cleared to 0, and the depth test is LESS. No fragment's depth is less than 0, so every depth-tested draw is rejected.
bugs.fix: Clear depth to 1 (clearDepth(1)).

bugs.symptom: The glass panel does not tint the crates. The crates look as if they are in front of it.
bugs.diagnosis: The glass panel is drawn before the crates. It is blended and does not write depth, so the crates, drawn afterwards, pass the depth test and cover it.
bugs.fix: Draw opaque objects first and blended ones after them.

bugs.symptom: After the first frame almost the whole canvas is black. Only a thin strip near the top-left still shows anything.
bugs.diagnosis: The scissor test is enabled to clip the health bar and never disabled. From the next frame on, the clear and every draw are clipped to the health bar's rectangle.
bugs.fix: Disable SCISSOR_TEST after drawing the health bar.

bugs.symptom: The crates have the wrong picture on them.
bugs.diagnosis: The crate draws do not bind the crate texture. They sample whatever is bound to unit 0 at the time, which is the minimap's render target.
bugs.fix: Bind the crate texture before drawing the crates.

bugs.symptom: The whole scene is tiny, squashed into the bottom-left corner of the canvas.
bugs.diagnosis: The viewport is still 64×64, as set for the minimap's render target, when the main scene is drawn to the canvas.
bugs.fix: Set the viewport back to the canvas size after rendering the minimap.

bugs.symptom: Memory use keeps growing for as long as the page runs.
bugs.diagnosis: A new 256×256 texture is created every frame for the minimap (makeMapTarget, called from renderMap) and the old one is never deleted.
bugs.fix: Create the minimap texture once, or delete the old one before replacing it.

bugs.symptom: The page stutters: frames take much longer than they should.
bugs.diagnosis: The sparks' shader program is compiled and linked again every frame.
bugs.fix: Build the program once and reuse it.

bugs.symptom: The minimap in the top-right corner is empty. It should show a yellow dot for each crate.
bugs.diagnosis: The minimap's texture is still bound to texture unit 0 while the minimap is rendered into it. That is a feedback loop: the browser rejects each of the three dot draws with INVALID_OPERATION, so nothing is drawn.
bugs.fix: Bind a different texture (or none) to the unit before rendering into the minimap texture.

bugs.symptom: The glass panel flickers: now and then, for a single frame, the crates behind it look as if they are in front of it.
bugs.diagnosis: On one frame in forty the glass panel is drawn before the crates instead of after them. It is blended and does not write depth, so on that frame the crates, drawn afterwards, cover it.
bugs.fix: Draw the glass after the crates on every frame: the order must not depend on the frame number.

bugs.symptom: This build adds a soft haze of sunlight over the whole scene. Since it went in, the frame costs many times the GPU time it did, and far more than a scene this simple should.
bugs.diagnosis: The haze is one full-screen draw whose fragment shader samples a texture 64 times in a loop for every pixel of the canvas. That draw takes nearly all of the frame's GPU time.
bugs.fix: Take far fewer samples in the loop (the haze is smooth, so a dozen or two look the same), or draw the haze at a lower resolution.

bugs.symptom: The three crates are missing.
bugs.diagnosis: The crates are drawn with a negative width, which reverses their winding. The pipeline culls back faces (cullMode back, frontFace cw), so every crate is culled: the three crate draws change no pixels.
bugs.fix: Do not flip a sprite with a negative size while the pipeline culls: use cullMode none for sprites, or flip the texture coordinates instead.

bugs.symptom: The crates are drawn black.
bugs.diagnosis: The crate texture has nine mip levels but only level 0 was ever written: the other eight are empty. The crates are drawn smaller than the texture, with a sampler whose mipmapFilter is linear, so they sample the empty levels.
bugs.fix: Write every mip level, or create the texture with one level.

bugs.symptom: The glass panel is opaque. The crates behind it cannot be seen through it.
bugs.diagnosis: The glass's pipeline has no blend state on its colour target, so the glass's colour replaces what is behind it instead of mixing with it.
bugs.fix: Give the glass pipeline's colour target a blend state: src-alpha, one-minus-src-alpha.

bugs.symptom: The ground is the wrong colour. It should be green.
bugs.diagnosis: The ground's uniform buffer is written without the padding the Sprite struct has. tint is a vec4f, so it sits at byte 32, after four bytes of padding that follow depth at byte 24. The ground's numbers are packed with tint straight after depth, at byte 28, so the shader reads tint one float late: (0.5, 0.2, 1, 0) instead of (0.25, 0.5, 0.2, 1).
bugs.fix: Write the ground's buffer with the layout every other sprite uses: one float of padding between depth and tint.

bugs.symptom: Only the sky and the HUD are drawn. The ground, the crates, the glass and the sparks are missing.
bugs.diagnosis: The scene pass clears its depth buffer to 0 (depthClearValue 0). Every pipeline that tests depth uses less, and nothing is nearer than 0, so every such draw fails the depth test.
bugs.fix: Clear depth to 1.

bugs.symptom: The glass panel does not tint the crates: they look as if they are in front of it.
bugs.diagnosis: The glass panel is drawn before the crates. It is blended and does not write depth, so the crates, drawn afterwards, cover it.
bugs.fix: Draw the glass after the crates.

bugs.symptom: The minimap is missing from the top-right corner.
bugs.diagnosis: The scissor rectangle set for the health bar (12, 12, 150×12) is never set back, so the minimap, drawn next in the same pass, is clipped away entirely.
bugs.fix: Set the scissor rectangle back to the whole target after drawing the health bar.

bugs.symptom: The crates have the wrong picture on them: an orange gradient instead of wooden planks.
bugs.diagnosis: The crates are drawn with the health bar's texture bind group in group 1 instead of the crate's own.
bugs.fix: Set the crate's bind group for the crates.

bugs.symptom: The whole scene is squashed into the top-left corner of the canvas.
bugs.diagnosis: The scene pass sets its viewport to 64×64, the minimap's size, so everything it draws lands in that corner of the 480×360 canvas.
bugs.fix: Do not set the viewport in the scene pass, or set it to the canvas size.

bugs.symptom: Memory use keeps growing for as long as the page runs.
bugs.diagnosis: A new 256×256 texture is created every frame for the minimap (makeMapTarget, called from renderMap) and the old one is never destroyed.
bugs.fix: Create the minimap texture once, or destroy the old one before replacing it.

bugs.symptom: The page stutters: frames take much longer than they should.
bugs.diagnosis: The sparks' shader module and render pipeline are created again every frame.
bugs.fix: Create the module and the pipeline once and reuse them.

bugs.symptom: The minimap is an empty black square: its yellow dots are missing.
bugs.diagnosis: The minimap pass ends with storeOp discard, so what it drew to the minimap texture is thrown away. The HUD then samples an empty texture.
bugs.fix: End the minimap pass with storeOp: 'store'.

bugs.symptom: The glass panel flickers: now and then, for a single frame, the crates behind it look as if they are in front of it.
bugs.diagnosis: On one frame in forty the glass panel is drawn before the crates instead of after them. It is blended and does not write depth, so on that frame the crates, drawn afterwards, cover it.
bugs.fix: Draw the glass after the crates on every frame: the order must not depend on the frame number.

bugs.symptom: This build adds a soft haze of sunlight over the whole scene. Since it went in, the frame costs many times the GPU time it did, and far more than a scene this simple should.
bugs.diagnosis: The haze is one full-screen draw whose fragment shader samples a texture 64 times in a loop for every pixel of the canvas. That draw takes nearly all of the frame's GPU time.
bugs.fix: Take far fewer samples in the loop (the haze is smooth, so a dozen or two look the same), or draw the haze at a lower resolution.

bugs.symptom: Nothing is drawn at all: the canvas is black.
bugs.diagnosis: The minimap pass draws its dots with the minimap's own bind group set in group 1, so the minimap texture is the pass's colour attachment and is bound for sampling in the same pass. WebGPU rejects that, the frame's command encoder becomes invalid, and none of the frame's commands run.
bugs.fix: Set the plain white texture group for the dots, as the other untextured sprites do.
